verdict.rationale: monday.com documents user-built agents that you create by describing a workflow, setting a goal and rules, then watching the results (docs-13, docs-14). It also documents scheduled automation of status updates and reports (docs-21), event-triggered runs when items are assigned, mentioned, or data changes (docs-15, docs-27), and admin audit of every agent action (docs-10). Together these show automations that run in the background without user intervention. Missing for 10: in-depth documentation of the end-user automation builder and its background execution limits, and independent or hands-on corroboration that agents and automations run reliably unattended.
